<!-- part: title -->
# Why a weekly team report breaks when one person builds it alone [s1]

<!-- part: story -->
Nadia runs a team of six reps. [s2]
She pastes it all into a sheet and builds the page at 9 pm on Sunday. [s3]

<!-- part: change -->
A manager sends invites. [s4]
Each rep connects their own export once. [s5]
The manager sees one weekly report for the whole team that still reads in two minutes. [s6]

<!-- part: proof -->
In the closed beta, managers reported 52 minutes to build the weekly team page before team seats and 11 minutes with them. [s7]

<!-- part: caveat -->
The beta group was self selected. [s8]

<!-- part: status -->
Team seats are in closed beta, with general release planned for February 24, 2027. [s9]
